summary: 18 backend pytest cases (6 files) and 8 named browser checks written and executed. All passed.

checks.criterion: Patient can complete/edit the health profile and run the bounded normal symptom assessment one question at a time
checks.name: test_tscheck_patient_assessment.py
checks.evidence: PUT /api/patient/profile 200; POST /api/assessment/session 200 (question_index=0/3); 3x POST /api/assessment/message progressing question_index 1,2,3 with final guidance == 'Based on your answers, please consult a doctor.', outcome=NORMAL; POST unknown session -> 404

checks.criterion: Patient can complete/edit the health profile and run the bounded normal symptom assessment one question at a time
checks.name: patient-profile-and-bounded-assessment
checks.evidence: Edited profile location field, saved and confirmed persisted value; ran 3-question assessment via UI, final panel shows exact text 'Based on your answers, please consult a doctor.'

checks.criterion: Medical document flow preserves originals and visibly separates unverified extraction from trusted history
checks.name: test_tscheck_document_flow.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/documents/upload (pdf) 200 review_status=needs_verification, original_available=true; POST verify -> 200 verified; unreadable filename -> review_status=unreadable, extracted_fields=[], verify -> 400; unsupported content-type -> 415

checks.criterion: Medical document flow preserves originals and visibly separates unverified extraction from trusted history
checks.name: document-upload-and-verification
checks.evidence: Uploaded readable PDF -> badge 'AI extracted — needs verification', clicked Review & verify -> badge becomes 'verified'; uploaded filename containing 'unreadable' -> badge 'Could not reliably extract information from this document.'

checks.criterion: Doctor normal access requires authorization and provides protected patient context
checks.name: test_tscheck_doctor_access.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/doctor/patients/lookup without authorization_granted -> 403; with authorization_granted=true + TECH-PT-001 -> 200 with patient allergies/medicines/history; unknown identifier -> 404

checks.criterion: Doctor normal access requires authorization and provides protected patient context
checks.name: doctor-authorization-required-lookup
checks.evidence: Find patient button disabled until authorization checkbox checked; after checking + TECH-PT-001 lookup, summary shows Maya Sharma, 29, Penicillin allergy, Salbutamol medicine, history entry

checks.criterion: Doctor can review bounded assistance, override it, match facilities by capabilities, and send a referral
checks.name: test_tscheck_doctor_referral.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/doctor/assessment-assistance -> mode=deterministic_demo, review mentions clinician confirmation required; GET /api/facilities/match ROUTINE and EMERGENCY return capability-filtered lists; POST /api/referrals -> 200 with Created/Sent/Received events, then GET /api/hospital/queue shows the new referral

checks.criterion: Doctor can review bounded assistance, override it, match facilities by capabilities, and send a referral
checks.name: doctor-ai-review-override-and-referral
checks.evidence: AI-assisted assessment card shows 'DETERMINISTIC DEMO ADAPTER' badge; Override assistance button sets doctor-authored override text and shows 'Doctor decision authoritative' badge; selected facility among 3 capability-tagged cards; Confirm & send referral shows success panel with new referral id

checks.criterion: Hospital combined operations queue prioritizes emergency items and supports valid lifecycle actions
checks.name: test_tscheck_hospital_queue.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/referrals/{id}/status Accepted->Arrived->Outcome Updated all 200 with growing event timeline; Rejected from Sent -> 200; invalid Sent->Arrived jump -> 409; SOS event appears in GET /api/hospital/queue emergencies with dispatch_status SIMULATED_DISPATCH

checks.criterion: Hospital combined operations queue prioritizes emergency items and supports valid lifecycle actions
checks.name: hospital-queue-emergency-priority-and-lifecycle
checks.evidence: Emergency queue section bounding box y-position above normal referral queue section; fresh referral progressed Accept->Mark arrived->Outcome saved with visible timeline; separate fresh referral exposed Reject/Redirect buttons while Sent and Reject transitioned it to Rejected

checks.criterion: SOS records simulated dispatch immediately before optional questions and continues through destination and hospital alert
checks.name: test_tscheck_sos_flow.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/sos -> 200 dispatch_status=SIMULATED_DISPATCH, message contains 'Emergency action initiated'; POST /api/sos/{id}/context (optional note) -> 200 non-blocking; POST /api/sos/select-facility -> 200 status=Hospital Alerted with referral_id, visible in GET /api/hospital/queue as emergency=true; unknown ids -> 404

checks.criterion: SOS records simulated dispatch immediately before optional questions and continues through destination and hospital alert
checks.name: sos-simulated-dispatch-and-hospital-alert
checks.evidence: Clicking SOS immediately shows 'EMERGENCY ACTION INITIATED' panel with SIMULATED_DISPATCH badge and real-emergency disclaimer; destination choice available immediately; selecting facility shows 'Hospital notified' state; switching to Hospital Operations shows new 'INCOMING EMERGENCY PATIENT' card

checks.criterion: Safety and simulation boundaries remain explicit throughout the app
checks.name: safety-and-simulation-labels-visible
checks.evidence: Header shows 'DETERMINISTIC DEMO ADAPTERS' and 'Demo environment · no real clinical or ambulance service connected'; doctor view shows 'Normal access requires authorization'; SOS panel shows demo-simulation/real-emergency disclaimer; hospital emergency card shows 'Break-glass access is limited and audited'

checks.criterion: Public desktop experience is usable without console or failed-request errors
checks.name: desktop-role-switcher-no-errors
checks.evidence: At 1280x720, patient/doctor/hospital workspaces all rendered with no horizontal scroll overflow (scrollWidth<=clientWidth), zero console errors (strict_console=true), and zero HTTP 4xx/5xx responses observed while switching roles
